Modifiers are extension methods that return a changed copy of the element, so you can chain them.

**Learn more:** [Forms and Input](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/controls/forms)

## `Immediate` [#immediate]

Requests that the control commit its value on every keystroke instead of on blur. Has no effect on controls whose default already fires per-keystroke (TextBox, PasswordBox, AutoSuggestBox, etc.).

```csharp
T Immediate<T>(this T el) where T : Element
```

Declared in `ImmediateExtensions`.

**Applies to:** any element.


Declared in `ErrorStylingExtensions`.

**Applies to:** any element.

## `Required` [#required]

Sets AutomationProperties.IsRequiredForForm. Screen readers announce "required".

```csharp
T Required<T>(this T el) where T : Element
```

Declared in `ElementExtensions`.

**Applies to:** any element.

**Example**

```csharp
TextBox(name, setName).Required()
```

## `Validate` [#validate]

```csharp
T Validate<T>(this T el, string fieldName, params IValidator[] validators) where T : Element
T Validate<T>(this T el, string fieldName, object? value, params IValidator[] validators) where T : Element
```

Declared in `ValidateExtensions`.

| Overload | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Validate<T>(T, string, IValidator[])` | Attaches validators to this element. The element's value will be validated against the provided validators, with results pushed to the nearest ValidationContext. |
| `Validate<T>(T, string, object?, IValidator[])` | Attaches validators to this element along with the current field value, and — when called from inside a component's `Render()` — runs them immediately against the enclosing [`ValidationContext`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/validation/ValidationContext).  Running during render rather than during reconcile is what makes the results readable by the same `Render()` that produced them, so `When(ctx.IsTouched(f) && ctx.HasError(f), …)` placed after this call sees the current verdict instead of the previous pass's.  The validators are still attached, so `FormField` keeps working for elements built outside a render pass. Re-running them is harmless: results are applied with a structural diff. The visualizers only \*display\* what a context already holds — they never run attached validators — so an element that reaches neither a render pass nor a `FormField` contributes no verdict. |

**Applies to:** any element.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fieldName` | `string` | Field name for validation messages. |
| `validators` | [`IValidator[]`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/validation/IValidator) | One or more validators to apply. |
| `value` | `object?` |  |

## `ValidateAsync` [#validateasync]

```csharp
T ValidateAsync<T>(this T el, string fieldName, params IAsyncValidator[] asyncValidators) where T : Element
T ValidateAsync<T>(this T el, string fieldName, object? value, params IAsyncValidator[] asyncValidators) where T : Element
```

Declared in `ValidateExtensions`.

| Overload | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ValidateAsync<T>(T, string, IAsyncValidator[])` | Attaches async validators to this element (in addition to any sync validators). |
| `ValidateAsync<T>(T, string, object?, IAsyncValidator[])` | Attaches async validators to this element along with the current field value, and registers the field so `MarkAllTouched()` covers it.  This overload is **attach-only**: it does not run the validators. Nothing consumes [`ValidationAttached.AsyncValidators`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/validation/attached#asyncvalidators) automatically — not the render scope, which must stay synchronous, and not `FormField`. Run them yourself from an effect via [`ValidationReconciler.ValidateFieldAsync`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/validation/ValidationReconciler#validatefieldasync), which carries the generation guard that discards a result superseded by a newer value.  Registration happens here for an element built during a render, and again when `FormField` mounts or updates it, which is the only chance an element assembled outside a render pass gets. |

**Applies to:** any element.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fieldName` | `string` |  |
| `asyncValidators` | [`IAsyncValidator[]`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/validation/IAsyncValidator) |  |
| `value` | `object?` |  |

```csharp

```

Declared in `ErrorStylingExtensions`.

**Applies to:** any element.
